description: A utility module for versioned, multi-algorithm password hashing and verification with tenant-specific salts and global pepper support. Includes functions for hashing, verifying, and ensuring tenant salts, supporting multiple hashing algorithms (argon2, bcrypt, scrypt) with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the global pepper value from environment variables, defaulting to an empty string if not set.

methods.name: buildHashInput
methods.description: Constructs the input string for hashing based on password, version, tenant, and global pepper.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using the preferred scheme (argon2, bcrypt, or scrypt fallback), with tenant-specific salt support.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using legacy static salt with scrypt, for verification of existing hashes.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against stored hash, determining algorithm by hash format and supporting migration from legacy.

methods.name: compareHash
methods.description: Compares a constructed input with a stored hash using the appropriate algorithm.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures a tenant has an orgSalt, generating and saving one if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Public wrapper to hash a password with specified version (defaults to v2).

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies a password and provides migration support if legacy hash is used.
